title: 3DOM Operation IR
description: The Intermediate Representation emitted by the IR builder from a parsed 3DOM program. Task accuracy is scored on THIS object, never on the surface string, so 3DOM and the Alien-Syntax language are graded against identical ground truth (SCORING_POLICY.md S6).

grammar_version.description: Stamped into EVERY IR object by the IR builder (SCORING_POLICY.md S6a). A row whose IR carries no version is unreportable.

source.description: Optional: the raw program the IR was built from. Kept for offline re-scoring; scorers MUST NOT read it.

ops.description: The operation list. LENGTH IS SEMANTIC: an empty array is the VALID-BUT-VACUOUS case (D5) - a parse success and a task failure on any task whose target IR has >= 1 op.

op.description: The operation verb. Task 1 (op-selection) reads exactly this field.

selector.description: The unresolved selector AST. Task 5 (selector-resolution) hands this to a fixture scene; it has NO meaning without one (TERMINOLOGY.md S4).

args.description: Operation arguments. Task 2 (arg-extraction) reads this. Keys are canonical by convention but the scorer canonicalises synonyms before comparing.

label.description: Optional human label proposed for the target part. Task 3 (labeling) reads this.

verb.description: The CLOSED verb set: 15 verbs, INVARIANT (METRICS.md). Never add or remove one - the Alien grammar must match this cardinality exactly.

selector.description: A selector is a SEQUENCE OF STEPS joined by combinators. `raw` is always present so a scorer can recover structure even when the builder emitted no `steps`.

raw.description: The literal selector text, e.g. '.car > .wheel'. Authoritative fallback: if `steps` is absent, the scorer re-parses this.

combinator.description: How this step attaches to the PREVIOUS step. null on the first step. 'child' is the `>` terminal - a syntactic LEAF whose MEANING is a one-level scene-graph walk (TERMINOLOGY.md). It has no AST children.

matchers.description: Matchers within one step are ANDed (a compound selector): '.front.wheel' is one step, two matchers.

kind.description: class='.x'  id='#x'  type=mesh|group|light|camera  pseudo=:selected|:lasso  wildcard='*'  label=a human label match.

name.description: The matcher payload. Absent only for kind='wildcard'.
